features: Mirrors the real Scoring Dashboard three-option structure into Scoring Tests: Manual, Automatic and Live Screen Projector
Adds Test Live Screen Projector active-round dashboard
Adds Test Heats, Semifinal and Final Projection Control using isolated Test scoring tables
Adds Test 9:16 Judges, Scoring, Callback, Finalist, Final Ranking and Top 5 Winner projection views
Adds Live Screen direct navigation to Automatic Test rounds
Introduces shared ScoringRoundNavigation service so Test and Real round navigation can converge on one component
Test projector is visibly marked TEST MODE and cannot publish official BDC results or points
Establishes development rule in code structure: scoring UI features should have shared Test and Real integration rather than Real-only patches
No official scoring calculations, results or BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
